page.layout: One column of running text. Above it: page number "6" at top left and the running head "DE ROM. PONTIFICUM" at top centre. Below the last line, at the right: catchword "Sixtus". No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rum confirmationes, missas, vestes ac Papistica sacra disponeret: qui & ipse à Cæsare Traiano, ad marmora secanda in exilium erat pulsus, & ancora ad collum eius appensa anno Domini 102. in mare tandem præcipitatus: certè non video. O diabolici Christianorum derisores Papistæ. Mantuanus enim in 11. Fastorum libro sic habet:

p.i: Hic quia Faustinam magni de sanguine Neruæ, Sisiniumq; virum illustrem cum coniuge Christo Subdiderat, Roma procul ablegatus ab urbe, Hellespontiacæ petiit confinia terræ, Peruenitq; Paron, lapides ubi multa secabant Millia Christigenum Parios, quibus alta theatra, Templa deum, regumq; domos ornare solebant.

main_text.head: 4. EVARISTVS Græcus.
main_text.p: Varistus Græcus, Dei gratia præfulgens, fide-l[?]ium Christianorum Ecclesiam concionibus sacris auxit, tempore persecutionum: donec esset anno Christi iio. sub dicto Traiano etiam martyrio sublatus.
main_text.head: 5. ALEXANDER Romanus.
main_text.p: Alexander Romanus Ecclesiam Romanam prædicado, & baptizando, in primis uuit[?]: qui Christiani nominis gratia, sub præside Aureliano sup-plicia gravissima, anno Domini 121. ad mortem us-que passus est.

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. The drop-cap at the start of the line "lium" is hard to read; it is given as l[?]. "Varistus" is printed without the h of Christian spelling; left as printed. "iio." for the year 110 is printed as "ııo" and is uncertain. "uuit" is printed unclear and is marked [?]. Underlining in the text is not transcribed. The "&" sign before "ipse" is printed in a special form; it is given as &. Verse lines are set in italic type and form one stanza.
